---
name: Issue Template
description: Standardized issue template for bug reports and feature requests
title: ""
labels: ["triage"]
assignees: ""
body: |
  Thanks for opening an issue! Please fill in the relevant sections below to help us understand and prioritize your request.

  ## Issue Type
  - [ ] Bug Report - Something isn't working as expected
  - [ ] Feature Request - New functionality or improvement
  - [ ] Documentation - Missing or unclear documentation
  - [ ] Question - Asking about usage or functionality
  - [ ] Good First Issue - Beginner-friendly task

  ## Description
  Provide a clear and concise description of the issue or feature request.

  ## Problem Statement (for Bug Reports & Feature Requests)
  What problem are you trying to solve? What is the current behavior vs expected behavior?

  ## Steps to Reproduce (for Bug Reports only)
  1. Go to '...'
  2. Run '....'
  3. See error

  ## Expected Behavior
  A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

  ## Actual Behavior
  A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

  ## Environment
  - OS: [e.g. macOS, Windows, Linux]
  - Node.js version: [e.g. v20.0.0]
  - Nebula-CLI version: [e.g. 5.6.0]
  - AI Provider: [e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, Groq]
  - Additional context: [any other relevant details]

  ## Possible Solution
  Have you thought about a possible solution? Provide ideas if you have any.

  ## Additional Context
  Add any other context about the issue here, such as error logs, screenshots, or use case details.
---
